excerpt: This course introduces students to the practice of data journalism, covering spreadsheet analysis, basic Python for data cleaning, and the use of public records to find and verify stories. Students will learn to scrape websites, work with CSV and JSON files, and build simple data visualizations using tools like Datawrapper and Flourish. Case studies include investigations into campaign finance, policing data, and climate records. By the end of the term, students will produce an original data-driven story suitable for publication, including a methodology note explaining how the data was gathered and checked for accuracy.
